column2: Since we came all the way to Alkmaar, you don't mind if I show my face at the Grand Lodge, right?{wait}{clear}
Yes, that's fine. But, Fein, there's something I'd like to ask you. May I?{wait}{clear}
Ha ha ha... You really are full of questions.{wait}{clear}

I'm sorry... I just want to learn all kinds of things about this world.{wait}{clear}Um, Alkmaar is a big city too, and the Six Kingdoms Alliance seems very developed. And there seem to be lots of Guild lodges...{wait}{clear}So I thought there might be some connection.{wait}{clear}

You really do see what's worth seeing. Just as you think, this country and the Guild are deeply connected.{wait}{clear}The Six Kingdoms Alliance uses the Guild's power in its politics, and in return, the Guild's safety is guaranteed.{wait}{clear}
So they help each other.{wait}{clear}

Yeah, in a sense. That's why most mages live in this region, too.{wait}{clear}"Mage" may sound imposing, but each one of us is no different from an ordinary person.{wait}{clear}So we can only live by being connected to lots of other people...{wait}{clear}Now that the Guild exists, mages can live in peace, but...{wait}{clear}Not long ago, there were lands where you'd be killed just for having a mage's power...{wait}{clear}That's also why mages trained in swordsmanship like me, called Warlocks, came to be.{wait}{clear}It began when the Guild trained young mages as a militia to protect themselves.{wait}{clear}
Ah, sorry. I've strayed from what you wanted to ask. But was that of some help, at least?{wait}{clear}
Yes, thank you. Also, Fein, what kind of work do you do as a Warlock?{wait}{clear}

Ordinary Warlocks guard the Guild lodges in the big towns, but I'm not a Warlock attached to a lodge.{wait}{clear}I travel to many countries gathering information. To protect the interests of the Guild as a whole...{wait}{clear}So looking for the cause of the world's turmoil with you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄, is useful for my own work too.{wait}{clear}I'm grateful to you.{wait}{clear}Well then, let's go to the Grand Lodge.{wait}{clear}
＄＄＄＄＄＄, are you there?{wait}{clear}
I met an old friend for the first time in ages, and we got to talking. Sorry about that.{wait}{clear}
No, please don't worry about that. You have your own life, Fein.{wait}{clear}
I see...{wait}{clear}
Please get some rest today, Fein.{wait}{clear}
Yeah. Good night, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}
Fein, are you going to see the Grand Master again?{wait}{clear}
Yeah. It'd be strange to come all this way and not show my face, right?{wait}{clear}I'll be back.{wait}{clear}
Fein... Has something big happened?{wait}{clear}

No, nothing that big has happened. But just as you feared, Elder, turmoil seems to be breaking out here and there.{wait}{clear}I don't think all of it is a portent of some great calamity, but the Empire seems to be growing active, and that worries me...{wait}{clear}

I see... All sorts of reports have been reaching us here lately, too.{wait}{clear}Among them are prophecies of a truly enormous calamity. The presence of a vast shadow that the prophets sense...{wait}{clear}But what exactly it is, we don't know... Regrettably.{wait}{clear}
Still, as a precaution, I had the Demon Stone brought here from Lefkas.{wait}{clear}
What? You mean the stone the previous Grand Master received from Marquis Zern?{wait}{clear}

Yes, that's the one. Whether that stone is truly the legendary Demon Stone, we don't know...{wait}{clear}As you, Zig's apprentice, know very well.{wait}{clear}But... we cannot ignore the words of the prophets.{wait}{clear}
Yes... you're right...{wait}{clear}
